description:
Animate Everflowing Chalice using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.cardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
